data.body: E06-01 remains incomplete for caller-attached failures held in errorLedger. ingestPreexistingErrors only visits secondaryFailures and allErrors, so a primary Error whose caller-owned errorLedger contains a genuine failure reference (for example, { error: closeError, phase: 'close', order: 2 }) never adds that failure to entries. A subsequently arriving frame/source/attachment Error is therefore recorded ahead of the already attached closeError, and getSerializedErrors/getSecondaryErrors omit closeError altogether. Merely retaining the original errorLedger array during refresh does not satisfy ingestion or chronological common-ledger exposure. Ingest genuine error references from caller-owned errorLedger entries, while leaving purely serialized diagnostic objects intact and skipping ledger-owned exposures.
data.title: E06-01 Ingest genuine failures attached through errorLedger
